item.title: Photo | A northern harrier on the hunt near Wilder Ranch State Park
item.description: A northern harrier glides above an artichoke field by Highway 1 near Wilder Ranch in Santa Cruz. The northern harrier, also known as the marsh hawk or ring-tailed hawk, is a bird of prey that is smaller than a red-tailed hawk. This species has a large range and can be seen above the Arctic Circle […]
